propositions: Mutating CLI verbs (link, unlink, comment, tag, edit, set-file-impact, etc.) currently exit silently on success, making idempotent no-ops indistinguishable from successful writes; agents must run follow-up 'rebar show' to verify writes, causing spurious failures and retries.

Every verb in _WRITES_FULL and _LIFECYCLE must emit a single one-line stdout confirmation on success (e.g., 'linked <src> -> <target> (<relation>)') and 'no change: <reason>' for idempotent no-ops, both exiting 0.
Already-printing verbs (create, idea, revert, claim, session-log, transition) must normalize to the shared confirmation contract without information loss, and reopen must gain a confirmation line.

Global --quiet/-q (suppresses confirmation text only) and --output/-o (promotes to router level, adds {'outcome', 'subject', 'detail'} JSON envelope) flags must work uniformly across all in-scope verbs including positional-only _REGISTRY leaves, with link's REDIRECT record byte-identical and never suppressed by --quiet.

Confirmations must route to stdout (result) and logs to stderr; consumed seam returns (e.g., add_dependency's dict|None REDIRECT contract) must remain unchanged; transition must preserve UNBLOCKED ids in its confirmation line.
